headline: Neuberger Berman on "Underweight" European Equities
summary: Neuberger Berman CIO Maya Bhandari says the firm recently cut back on global equities to "target" for the first time in four years, with Europe underweight due to its cyclical bias, heavy concentration in autos and banks, and limited AI exposure.
